<script>

document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
  const fetchSuggestions = async (query, limit = 5) => {
    if (!query) return [];
    const res = await fetch(
      `/ajax/get_suggest_word/?keyword=${encodeURIComponent(query)}&suggest_limit=${limit}`,
      { headers: { 'X-Requested-With': 'XMLHttpRequest' } }
    );
    const json = await res.json();
    return Array.isArray(json.suggest)
      ? json.suggest.map(([word]) => word)
      : [];
  };

  
  const commonConfig = {
    wrapper: true,
    searchEngine: 'loose',
    threshold: 2,
    debounce: 400,
    resultItem: { highlight: true },
    events: {
      input: {
        selection: (event) => {
          const selection = event.detail.selection.value;
          event.target.value = selection;
        }
      }
    }
  };

  const initAutoComplete = ({ selector, placeHolder, limit }) => {
    
    if (!document.querySelector(selector)) {
      return;
    }

    return new autoComplete({
      selector,
      placeHolder,
      maxResults: limit,
      resultsList: { maxResults: limit },
      data: {
        src: query => fetchSuggestions(query, limit),
        cache: false
      },
      ...commonConfig
    });
  };

  
  initAutoComplete({
    selector: '.search-keyword-input',
    placeHolder: 'Search for Used Car',
    limit: 10
  });

  
  initAutoComplete({
    selector: '.sp-search-keyword-input',
    placeHolder: 'Search by Make, Model (e.g. Toyota)',
    limit: 5
  });
});
</script>

$(function() {
	var loadLocalServiceFlags = function() {
		$('#gn-be-forward-local-content image[data-src]').each(function() {
			var src = this.getAttribute('data-src');
			if (!src) {
				return;
			}
			this.setAttribute('href', src);
			this.setAttributeNS('http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink', 'xlink:href', src);
			this.removeAttribute('data-src');
		});
	};
	var $localServiceMenu = $('#gn-be-forward-local');
	var localServiceFlagTimer = null;
	$localServiceMenu.on('mouseenter.bfLocalServiceFlags', function() {
		clearTimeout(localServiceFlagTimer);
		localServiceFlagTimer = setTimeout(function() {
			if (!$localServiceMenu.find('.mm-item-content:visible').length) {
				return;
			}
			$localServiceMenu.off('.bfLocalServiceFlags');
			loadLocalServiceFlags();
		}, 100);
	}).on('mouseleave.bfLocalServiceFlags', function() {
		clearTimeout(localServiceFlagTimer);
	});
	$localServiceMenu.one('focusin.bfLocalServiceFlags touchstart.bfLocalServiceFlags', function() {
		clearTimeout(localServiceFlagTimer);
		$localServiceMenu.off('.bfLocalServiceFlags');
		loadLocalServiceFlags();
	});
	// Megamenu
	$('.megamenu').megamenu({
		mm_timeout: 50,

	// AccountにhoverするとHello, nameも色が変わるように

	});

	// Cartにhoverするとカートアイコンも色が変わるように
	$('.header-count-link').hover(function () {
		$('#header-count').children('img.cart-icon-img').attr('src', '/assets/images/header_gloval_nav_icon/icon-btn-cart-orange.png');

		isSupporters = cookie_supporters_check();
		change_bfs_menu(isSupporters);

		// Depositリンク非表示国を取得
		is_not_show_deposit_link = cookie_deposit_check();
		not_deposit_link(is_not_show_deposit_link);
	}else{
		change_sign_info('out');
	}

	function change_sign_info(sign_status){
		if(sign_status == 'in'){
			$('#sign-out').show();
			$('#point-view').show();
			$('#myaccount-name-wrap').show();
			$('#header-count').show();
			$('#mypage-buynow-cars-box').show();
		}else if(sign_status == 'out'){
			$('#sign-in').show();
			$('#point-view').hide();
			$('#myaccount-name-wrap').hide();
			$('#buynow-button-wrap').hide();

			//202010B017_FrontNoLoginFavorite ヘッダのお気に入りは常時表示
			// $('#header-count').hide();
			$('#header-count').show();
            $('#fn-header-middle-buynow').hide();

			$('#mypage-buynow-cars-box').hide();
		}
	}

	function change_bfs_menu(register_status){
		if(register_status == true){
			$('#non_supporters_menu').hide();
			$('#supporters_menu').show();
		}else if(register_status == false){
			$('#non_supporters_menu').show();
			$('#supporters_menu').hide();
		}
		return;
	}

	function not_deposit_link(deposit_status){
		if(deposit_status == true){
			$('#deposit_link').hide();
		}else if(deposit_status == false){
			$('#deposit_link').show();
		}
		return;
	}

	// ▼ カウントダウンタイマーの設定
	function countDownTimer() {
		var deadline = new Date("January 4,2022, 23:59:59 +0900");
		var deadlineTime = deadline.getTime();
		var deadlineOffset = deadline.getTimezoneOffset() * 60000;
		var deadlineUtc = deadlineTime + deadlineOffset;

		var now = new Date();
		var nowTime = now.getTime();
		var nowOffset = now.getTimezoneOffset() * 60000;
		var nowUtc = nowTime + nowOffset;

		var leftTime = deadlineUtc - nowUtc;

		var leftDays = 0;
		var leftHours = 0;
		var leftMins = 0;
		var leftSecs = 0;
		if (leftTime > 0) {
			// 残りの時間を計算
			leftDays = Math.floor(leftTime/(24*60*60*1000));
			leftHours = Math.floor((leftTime % (24*60*60*1000))/(60*60*1000));
			leftMins = Math.floor((leftTime % (24*60*60*1000))/(60*1000))%60;
			leftSecs = Math.floor((leftTime % (24*60*60*1000))/1000)%60%60;
		}else{
			clearInterval(timer);
		}

		$(".count-days").text(( '0' + leftDays ).slice(-2));
		$(".count-hours").text(( '0' + leftHours ).slice(-2));
		$(".count-minutes").text(( '0' + leftMins ).slice(-2));
		$(".count-seconds").text(( '0' + leftSecs ).slice(-2));
	}
	var timer = setInterval(countDownTimer, 1000);

	// 言語変更処理(ヘッダーメニューでの言語変更)
    $('#lang-switch-menu li').click(function(){
		// 選択した言語を取得
		var lang = $(this).data('lang');
		set_language_cookie(lang);
    });

});

			var url          = $submit_form.find('.fn-currency-url-' + currency).val();

			}
		});

			mouseout:function(){
				$('#currency-switch-area').hide();

	});

$(function () {
  var activate_flag = false;
  var header_search_keyword_action = function (e) {
    e.stopPropagation();
    e.preventDefault();

    if (activate_flag) {
      console.error('double click');
      return false;
    }

    // 検索実行Formの選定
    var form_id = 'tmpFm';
    if ($('#listFm').length > 0) {
      // StockList画面の場合
      form_id = 'listFm';
    } else if ($('#schFm').length > 0) {
      // Top画面の場合
      form_id = 'schFm';
    }
    var form_selector = '#' + form_id;
    var $inputs = $('.header-search-keyword-area').find('input[type=text]');
    if ($inputs.length > 0) {
      var keys = [];
      $inputs.each(function (e) {
        var $e = $(this);
        $('<input>').attr({ type: 'hidden', name: $e.attr('name'), value: $e.val() }).appendTo(form_selector);
      });
      // 検索モード
      var kmode_value = $('select[name=kmode]').val();
      if (!kmode_value) {
        kmode_value = 'and';
      }
      $('<input>').attr({ type: 'hidden', name: 'kmode', value: kmode_value }).appendTo(form_selector);

      // オプションの表示
      var showmore = e.data;
      if (showmore === 'top_advanced_search') {
        $('input[name=showmore]').val(1);
      }
    }
    activate_flag = true;
    return searchFormAction(document.getElementById(form_id));
  };

  // ヘッダー部分の検索ボタンクリック
  $('#header-anchor-of-search-button').click(function (e) {
    searchBarOnly();
    return header_search_keyword_action(e);
  });
  $(document).on('keydown', '#header-search-keyword', function (e) {
    // ヘッダーの検索フォーム内でEnterキー押下
    if (e.key === 'Enter') {
      searchBarOnly();
      return header_search_keyword_action(e);
    }
  });

  // ヘッダー部分以外のリンク等から検索実行するための入口
  $('#dummy-anchor-of-search-button').click(function (e) {
    return header_search_keyword_action(e);
  });

  // Advanced Searchクリック
  $('#top-advanced-search').click('top_advanced_search', function (e) {
    return header_search_keyword_action(e);
  });

  // Search Barの入力項目のみで検索
  function searchBarOnly() {
    // Stocklist画面の場合のみ適用
    if ($('#listFm').length !== 1) {
      return;
    }

    // フリーワードの入力がある場合のみ適用
    var keyword = $('#header-search-keyword').val();
    if (keyword === '') {
      return;

<script>

document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
  const fetchSuggestions = async (query, limit = 5) => {
    if (!query) return [];
    const res = await fetch(
      `/ajax/get_suggest_word/?keyword=${encodeURIComponent(query)}&suggest_limit=${limit}`,
      { headers: { 'X-Requested-With': 'XMLHttpRequest' } }
    );
    const json = await res.json();
    return Array.isArray(json.suggest)
      ? json.suggest.map(([word]) => word)
      : [];
  };

  
  const commonConfig = {
    wrapper: true,
    searchEngine: 'loose',
    threshold: 2,
    debounce: 400,
    resultItem: { highlight: true },
    events: {
      input: {
        selection: (event) => {
          const selection = event.detail.selection.value;
          event.target.value = selection;
        }
      }
    }
  };

  const initAutoComplete = ({ selector, placeHolder, limit }) => {
    
    if (!document.querySelector(selector)) {
      return;
    }

    return new autoComplete({
      selector,
      placeHolder,
      maxResults: limit,
      resultsList: { maxResults: limit },
      data: {
        src: query => fetchSuggestions(query, limit),
        cache: false
      },
      ...commonConfig
    });
  };

  
  initAutoComplete({
    selector: '.search-keyword-input',
    placeHolder: 'Search for Used Car',
    limit: 10
  });

  
  initAutoComplete({
    selector: '.sp-search-keyword-input',
    placeHolder: 'Search by Make, Model (e.g. Toyota)',
    limit: 5
  });
});
</script>

	}

	function not_deposit_link(deposit_status){

		}
		return;
	}

	// ▼ カウントダウンタイマーの設定
	function countDownTimer() {
		var deadline = new Date("January 4,2022, 23:59:59 +0900");
		var deadlineTime = deadline.getTime();
		var deadlineOffset = deadline.getTimezoneOffset() * 60000;
		var deadlineUtc = deadlineTime + deadlineOffset;

		var now = new Date();
		var nowTime = now.getTime();
		var nowOffset = now.getTimezoneOffset() * 60000;
		var nowUtc = nowTime + nowOffset;

		var leftTime = deadlineUtc - nowUtc;

		var leftDays = 0;
		var leftHours = 0;
		var leftMins = 0;
		var leftSecs = 0;
		if (leftTime > 0) {
			// 残りの時間を計算
			leftDays = Math.floor(leftTime/(24*60*60*1000));
			leftHours = Math.floor((leftTime % (24*60*60*1000))/(60*60*1000));
			leftMins = Math.floor((leftTime % (24*60*60*1000))/(60*1000))%60;
			leftSecs = Math.floor((leftTime % (24*60*60*1000))/1000)%60%60;
		}else{
			clearInterval(timer);
		}

		$(".count-days").text(( '0' + leftDays ).slice(-2));
		$(".count-hours").text(( '0' + leftHours ).slice(-2));
		$(".count-minutes").text(( '0' + leftMins ).slice(-2));
		$(".count-seconds").text(( '0' + leftSecs ).slice(-2));
	}
	var timer = setInterval(countDownTimer, 1000);

			var url          = $submit_form.find('.fn-currency-url-' + currency).val();
			if(url){
				$submit_form.attr('action', url);
			}

			$submit_form.submit();
		});

		$('#currency-switch').on({
			mouseover:function(){

				$('#currency-switch-area').hide();
			}
		});
		$('#currency-switch-area').on({
			mouseout:function(){
				$('#currency-switch-area').hide();
			}
		});
	});

$(function () {
  var activate_flag = false;
  var header_search_keyword_action = function (e) {
    e.stopPropagation();
    e.preventDefault();

    if (activate_flag) {
      console.error('double click');
      return false;
    }

    // 検索実行Formの選定
    var form_id = 'tmpFm';
    if ($('#listFm').length > 0) {
      // StockList画面の場合
      form_id = 'listFm';
    } else if ($('#schFm').length > 0) {
      // Top画面の場合
      form_id = 'schFm';
    }
    var form_selector = '#' + form_id;
    var $inputs = $('.header-search-keyword-area').find('input[type=text]');
    if ($inputs.length > 0) {
      var keys = [];
      $inputs.each(function (e) {
        var $e = $(this);
        $('<input>').attr({ type: 'hidden', name: $e.attr('name'), value: $e.val() }).appendTo(form_selector);
      });
      // 検索モード
      var kmode_value = $('select[name=kmode]').val();
      if (!kmode_value) {
        kmode_value = 'and';
      }
      $('<input>').attr({ type: 'hidden', name: 'kmode', value: kmode_value }).appendTo(form_selector);

      // オプションの表示
      var showmore = e.data;
      if (showmore === 'top_advanced_search') {
        $('input[name=showmore]').val(1);
      }
    }
    activate_flag = true;
    return searchFormAction(document.getElementById(form_id));
  };

  // ヘッダー部分の検索ボタンクリック
  $('#header-anchor-of-search-button').click(function (e) {
    searchBarOnly();
    return header_search_keyword_action(e);
  });
  $(document).on('keydown', '#header-search-keyword', function (e) {
    // ヘッダーの検索フォーム内でEnterキー押下
    if (e.key === 'Enter') {
      searchBarOnly();
      return header_search_keyword_action(e);
    }
  });

  // ヘッダー部分以外のリンク等から検索実行するための入口
  $('#dummy-anchor-of-search-button').click(function (e) {
    return header_search_keyword_action(e);
  });

  // Advanced Searchクリック
  $('#top-advanced-search').click('top_advanced_search', function (e) {
    return header_search_keyword_action(e);
  });

  // Search Barの入力項目のみで検索
  function searchBarOnly() {
    // Stocklist画面の場合のみ適用
    if ($('#listFm').length !== 1) {
      return;
    }

    // フリーワードの入力がある場合のみ適用
    var keyword = $('#header-search-keyword').val();
    if (keyword === '') {
      return;
    }

    // 検索ボックスリセット
    runReset();
  }

  // キーワード検索フォームの横幅を調整する
  function fixSearchKeywordWidth() {
    var w = $('#in-header-middle-wrap').outerWidth(true) - $('#header-count').outerWidth(true) - $('.header-account-info-wrap').outerWidth(true) - $('.search-keyword-menu').outerWidth(true) - $('#header-search-button').outerWidth(true);
    w -= 50; // 余白分
    $('#header-search-keyword').width(w);
  }

  $(window).resize(function () {
    fixSearchKeywordWidth();
  });
  fixSearchKeywordWidth();
});
</script>

<script>

document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
  const fetchSuggestions = async (query, limit = 5) => {
    if (!query) return [];
    const res = await fetch(
      `/ajax/get_suggest_word/?keyword=${encodeURIComponent(query)}&suggest_limit=${limit}`,
      { headers: { 'X-Requested-With': 'XMLHttpRequest' } }
    );
    const json = await res.json();
    return Array.isArray(json.suggest)
      ? json.suggest.map(([word]) => word)
      : [];
  };

  
  const commonConfig = {
    wrapper: true,
    searchEngine: 'loose',
    threshold: 2,
    debounce: 400,
    resultItem: { highlight: true },
    events: {
      input: {
        selection: (event) => {
          const selection = event.detail.selection.value;
          event.target.value = selection;
        }
      }
    }
  };

  const initAutoComplete = ({ selector, placeHolder, limit }) => {
    
    if (!document.querySelector(selector)) {
      return;
    }

    return new autoComplete({
      selector,
      placeHolder,
      maxResults: limit,
      resultsList: { maxResults: limit },
      data: {
        src: query => fetchSuggestions(query, limit),
        cache: false
      },
      ...commonConfig
    });
  };

  
  initAutoComplete({
    selector: '.search-keyword-input',
    placeHolder: 'Search for Used Car',
    limit: 10
  });

  
  initAutoComplete({
    selector: '.sp-search-keyword-input',
    placeHolder: 'Search by Make, Model (e.g. Toyota)',
    limit: 5
  });
});
</script>
